parsed.why: No facility ban, statutory gender-identity protections since 2013, penalty enhancement, easy marker change, low-risk tier — but parent passport, entry-screening and custody regimes still bind the visitor.

2016 bathroom law repealed and no current facility ban, but no statewide non-discrimination, no hate-crime coverage of gender identity, amended certificates retain original sex, and a bathroom bill is revived.

Low-risk tier, governor vetoing anti-trans bills, employment protections and nine city ordinances, no documented violence; offset by panic defence, no state hate-crime cover, youth-targeting policies and dissolved Pride.

Broadest local protections: statutory/commissioned gender-identity discrimination bans with remedies, X markers on licences, open marker change, sanctuary-city shielding of travellers, no enacted facility or sports bans.

Worst-tier state with universal facility exclusion by statutory sex definition covering bathrooms, shelters, dorms and prisons, religious-refusal exemptions, no statewide non-discrimination, on top of the hostile parent framework.
